headline: Highest risk is prompt-injection and cascading-error from shared file/clipboard workflows; data leakage and compliance risks are lower but non-zero.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop can read uploaded files, screenshots, clipboard, and files from supported macOS apps, while MinerU can ingest local documents and expose them through API/MCP workflows. That creates a plausible content-bridging path where attacker-controlled document text from MinerU can be copied into ChatGPT and treated as instructions. No direct shared channel is documented, so uncertainty keeps this at medium.
conditions: IF MinerU output is copied into ChatGPT Desktop via clipboard or file export
IF ChatGPT Desktop is asked to follow instructions embedded in extracted document text
mitigations: Paste MinerU output into a plain-text buffer first
Strip instruction-like text from extracted documents before review
Use separate workspaces for extraction and analysis
Disable clipboard bridging during review sessions
requires-engineering: add provenance labels to MinerU outputs

B_data_leakage.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop touches uploaded files, screenshots, voice, and connected-IDE code, and sends requests to api.openai.com; MinerU processes local PDFs, images, DOCX, PPTX, and XLSX and can serve results via API/MCP. If the same sensitive document is processed by both, content can flow from local files into a third-party inference backend. The pair lacks a documented isolation boundary, so leakage is plausible in default use.
conditions: IF the same sensitive file is opened in MinerU and then uploaded or pasted into ChatGPT Desktop
IF ChatGPT Desktop is used with connected IDE files or screenshots containing secrets
mitigations: Avoid sending sensitive documents to both agents
Redact secrets before analysis
Use separate datasets for extraction and reasoning
Review API routing for MinerU before processing regulated data
requires-engineering: enforce per-agent data-loss-prevention policies

C_capability_conflict.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop has no filesystem write, shell, or git modification, while MinerU also lacks filesystem write and git modification. Their write-capability overlap is therefore minimal, and the main shared surface is read/ingest rather than concurrent mutation. Because MinerU can use MCP and ChatGPT can consume files, a small coordination risk remains, but not a destructive write conflict.
conditions: IF both agents are pointed at the same mutable external resource through MCP or a shared API
IF an operator manually copies outputs between them during concurrent work
mitigations: Keep both agents read-only on shared inputs
Avoid concurrent edits to the same external system
Use one agent as the sole writer
Document which agent owns each artifact

D_cascading_error.rationale: MinerU is a document-processing system that can emit OCR text, tables, and extracted structure, and ChatGPT Desktop can read files and app context. If MinerU output is treated as authoritative by ChatGPT, extraction errors can cascade into downstream reasoning or user-facing summaries. There is no built-in verification step shown in either profile, so medium is warranted.
conditions: IF ChatGPT Desktop uses MinerU extraction as the sole source for a summary or decision
IF OCR or layout errors from MinerU are not manually checked before reuse
mitigations: Cross-check extracted fields against the source document
Sample-verify a few pages before trusting full extraction
Require human review for any downstream action
Keep raw source files alongside extracted output
requires-engineering: add confidence scoring and validation gates

E_compliance.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop routes some traffic to api.openai.com and touches uploaded files, screenshots, voice, and connected-IDE code; MinerU is documented as private/offline but also exposes REST/FastAPI/MCP interfaces. If regulated or residency-bound data is processed by both, differing retention and routing expectations can create a compliance mismatch. The profiles do not specify HIPAA/GDPR/DPA details, so uncertainty is resolved upward to medium.
conditions: IF EU PII or regulated documents are processed through ChatGPT Desktop
IF MinerU is deployed with networked API/MCP access for the same data class
mitigations: Restrict regulated data to one agent only
Check retention settings before processing sensitive files
Use local-only workflows for residency-bound data
Record which datasets may leave the local environment
requires-engineering: obtain a DPA and formal residency review
